lines: By this practice-yoga, having pierced Śiva, supreme should go; hands below clavicle having made, left foot and on right.
l4.sanskrit_cite: anenābhyāsayogena śivaṃ bhittvā paraṃ vrajet jatrvadhastātkarau kṛtvā vāmapādaṃ ca dakṣiṇe
